An '''[[Alien/Legends|alien]] race''' with huge, muscular bodies and heads that resembled the tips of stalks on their necks. No [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] or [[Nose/Legends|noses]] were visible on their heads, and a small opening revealed their [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]]. [[Plattahr]] was a member of the [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="MaraJade4" />
